criteria.criterion: All attempts for one immutable charge request use the same validated idempotency key, and concurrent/replayed calls cause at most one provider capture.
criteria.evidence: Requires new durable deduplication behavior and tests; current code only echoes the key.

criteria.criterion: A timeout after capture enters an unknown/pending state and is reconciled by key before any operation capable of creating another capture.
Before webhook settlement, the UI distinguishes pending/unknown/retrying from terminal succeeded or failed, and settlement resolves the visible state consistently.
criteria.evidence: Required because ui/status.py declares rendering before settlement and has no current state model.

criteria.criterion: Retryable failures have a documented finite attempt limit and backoff; permanent failures terminate without retry and preserve the charge key for diagnosis.
criteria.evidence: No retry policy or failure taxonomy currently exists.

options.option: Retry only bounded, definitively transient pre-capture failures with the same request-bound key; mark post-capture timeouts pending and reconcile before any further capture.
options.tradeoff: Safest against duplicate charges, but not every observed failure immediately produces another capture attempt.

options.option: Retry every non-terminal and ambiguous outcome with the same key, after implementing durable idempotency/deduplication and bounded backoff.
options.tradeoff: Closest safe interpretation of automatic retry, but requires gateway/storage contracts absent from this repository.

options.option: Retry every observed failure literally with the current key passthrough only.
options.tradeoff: Smallest local change, but duplicate captures and unbounded retries cannot be prevented with current evidence.

summary.affected: Payers, merchant balances, charge records, and reconciliation
summary.changed_feature: Automatic retries for failed payment.charge attempts
summary.possible_issue: A timeout after a successful capture may be retried as a new capture and debit the payer twice.
summary.prevention: Reuse one request-bound idempotency key backed by durable provider/application deduplication, and reconcile ambiguous outcomes before another capture.
summary.trigger: The provider captures funds and the caller observes TIMEOUT_AFTER_CAPTURE as a failure.

summary.affected: Customers and support staff relying on payment status
summary.possible_issue: The UI may show failed or retrying even though capture succeeded, or show success before settlement.
summary.prevention: Expose an explicit pending/unknown state and allow webhook or reconciliation to make the terminal transition.
summary.trigger: A charge is retried or has an ambiguous outcome before its settlement webhook.

summary.affected: Payment workers, provider quotas, operations, and customers awaiting a final state
summary.possible_issue: Permanent declines or persistent outages can create an endless retry loop and sustained provider load.
summary.prevention: Define retryable versus terminal outcomes, bounded attempts with backoff, and a final operational state.
summary.trigger: A non-retryable failure or repeated transient failure is classified only as failed.
